Name: Pebble
Draw: a small water-rounded grey pebble, smooth and dull, one pale band running across it; one pearl inlay etched into its face

Name: Agate
Draw: a tumbled agate nodule, concentric grey and cream bands under a soft waxy sheen; two pearl inlays etched side by side into its face

Name: Banded Agate
Draw: a sliced banded agate, tight concentric rings of orange and white, one cut face polished flat; etched into the polished face, two pearl inlays on the left and two onyx inlays on the right

Name: Jasper
Draw: a broken lump of red jasper, opaque brick red mottled with ochre, fresh shell-shaped fracture; three pearl inlays etched in a row into its face

Name: Bloodstone
Draw: a polished dome of dark green bloodstone, scattered blood-red flecks across its face; etched into the polished face, three pearl inlays on the left and two onyx inlays on the right

Name: Onyx
Draw: a squared block of black onyx with crisp white banding, mirror-polished; four pearl inlays etched in a row into the polished face

Name: Obsidian
Draw: a knapped obsidian core, glassy black with razor-sharp facets and a thin warm sheen; five pearl inlays etched in a row into its broadest facet

Name: Tourmaline
Draw: a long tourmaline crystal banded green, blue, yellow, red and violet along its length, deeply striated faces glowing from inside; no inlays
